div.div: calc expressions and script steps compile with the profile (limits: script ≤ 64 KiB, call depth 16, …). A compile error is a profile error, so a broken step never reaches ingest; at run time a calc that cannot evaluate leaves the record unchanged.

div.div: Pipeline = the parser’s own steps first, then [[pipeline]] steps in profile order. Disabled steps stay as no-op placeholders so step indexes and StepStats line up with the profile; a plugin step needs an installed transform id.
